items.title: Expectations of the Gaussian mixtures

source.anchor: arXiv:2610.20492v1 AppendixB2.2 radial test/H half-mass expectation identity immediately before Eq20, with Section3.1 single-block mixture before Eq6 and Section2 conditioned full Haar.
source.attribution: Huanjian Zhou and Taiji Suzuki, On Complexity of Gaussian Sampling. The source half-mass identity is made explicit on the actual mixture measures; omitted integration bookkeeping is supplied background. Source H uses the existing component density representation; this statement uses its actual Gaussian expectation representation.

items.statement:
For \(n\ge3\), \(\kappa\ge4\) and \(\ell\ge0\), the radial test is integrable under both actual Gaussian mixtures. Their expectations are the corresponding component averages, and their difference is twice the signed Haar average. Here \(A_O= rac{\kappa+1}{2}I_n- rac{\kappa-1}{4}(O+O^	op)\), \(\mu\) is full normalized Haar, \(
u_\pm=2\mu|_{\{\det O=\pm1\}}\), \(\gamma_O=\mathcal N(0,A_O^{-1})\), \(P_\pm=
u_\pm\mathbin{\mathrm{bind}}\gamma\), \(t(x)=e^{-\ell\|x\|^2}\), and \(f(O)=\int t\,d\gamma_O\). The conclusions include absolute L1 of \(t\) under both \(P_\pm\), absolute L1 of \(f\) under both \(
u_\pm\), both real identities \(\mathbb E_{P_\pm}t=\int f\,d
u_\pm\), and \(\mathbb E_{P_+}t-\mathbb E_{P_-}t=2\int_{O(n)}\det(O)\,f(O)\,d\mu(O).\)
assumptions: Exactly \(n\ge3\), \(\kappa\ge4\), \(\ell\ge0\), including \(\ell=0\). No integrability or measurable-family premise is supplied.
\(\mu\) is normalized Borel Haar on full real \(O(n)\); \(\nu_\pm=2\mu|_{\{\det O=\pm1\}}\). Both are the actual prior measures.
\(\gamma_O=\mathcal N(0,A_O^{-1})\), \(P_\pm=\nu_\pm\mathbin{\mathrm{bind}}\gamma\), and all expectations are real Bochner integrals on actual Borel Euclidean space.

The source defines \(H\) with component densities. Its actual Gaussian representation is supplied by the existing law-density/expectation interfaces. This packet proves the actual mixture expectation identity, while the quantitative Eq21 evaluation and TV inequality remain separate.

obligations.label: Actual radial-test L1, real expectation transports and exact signed half-mass gap

bindings.boundary: Actual radial-test L1 under both literal conditioned mixture laws, component-expectation L1 under both literal priors, both real Bochner transports and exact difference=2 signed actual Gaussian Haar expectation, at n>=3,kappa>=4,ell>=0 including zero. Density representation of source H and Eq21 evaluation are existing separate interfaces, not re-proved here. No TV inequality, Eq6 product, spherical/Poisson, parameter/transcript/eigenbasis or main query lower bound. Purification and full-paper completion separate.
